episodes.title: Cara Pintada
episodes.summary: On a mission to eliminate "Matias" – codename for one of the most wanted rebels in the region – a special forces commando team is plunged into the fog and darkness of the jungle, where they face a fearsome counterattack from an unexplainable force.

episodes.title: Mobuya Tir Toro
episodes.summary: Trapped in a cave and anticipating another attack, Díaz and Jackson search for an exit, while Rojas tries to get the team to the extraction point before it's too late. A flashback from the 16th century reveals that a gang of renegade mercenaries came face-to-face with the same deadly enemy once before.

episodes.title: Peso Muerto
episodes.summary: As Pardo fights her captor, Rojas' group brings Trébol to an abandoned house in hopes of saving his life. While searching for survivors of the helicopter crash, Jackson discovers that the group has been misled, and later, the men come upon a fearful stranger. Back in the 16th century, the surviving mercenaries witness a terrible ritual.

episodes.title: Young & Stupid
episodes.summary: In the middle of the storm, the commandos stumble upon an abandoned hydroelectric plant – and are stunned by what they find. After locking Flor up, Rojas must decide the right path forward. Just when an unexpected discovery offers an alternative means of escape from the jungle, the squad encounters a new danger.

episodes.title: Corre
episodes.summary: In the fire's aftermath, the commandos realize that the perimeter is surrounded by Matías' warriors and brace for a brutal attack that leaves them cornered. With half of the team fighting to hold off the enemy, Rojas leads the others through a series of the tunnels in search of an escape route, but his past trauma haunts his efforts.

episodes.title: Contagio
episodes.summary: Though the commandos manage to make it out of the plant's tunnels, what lies ahead may be far worse. During a race through the swamps, Pardo's illness intensifies – much to the detriment of those closest to her. Rojas and Castillo come upon a strange town, and back at the military base, an infected soldier unleashes chaos.

episodes.title: La Bestia
episodes.summary: After he and Castillo are forced to fight a fearsome opponent to the death, Rojas is questioned about his past ahead of an ancient ritual… involving Flor. Meanwhile, in the middle of the jungle, the remaining commandos face their worst nightmares.
